name: CorpusIQ
description: One hosted MCP server with read-only access to more than 40 business systems through a single OAuth connection: Shopify, Stripe, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Ads, Mailchimp, Airtable, Notion, Slack, Monday, eBay, Amazon Seller and more. Answers a question that spans several systems at once, and returns every figure alongside the source system it came from. External source tools never write back to a connected vendor system. A 30-day trial needs no credit card.
